errors.capTitle: This goes over your 30-day PIX limit
errors.capBody: You have {{amount}} left. The limit resets on {{date}}.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.PIX_BUSY: Another PIX purchase is in progress. Try again.
errors.PIX_UNAVAILABLE: PIX payment isn't available right now.
errors.PIX_NOT_ELIGIBLE: PIX payment isn't available for this account.

checkout.instructions: Copy the code and paste it into Pix in your bank's app, or scan the QR from another phone. This screen updates by itself once you pay.
checkout.notCancellable: This PIX can't be cancelled: the payment just came in.

delivered.title: Payment received!
delivered.body: Your purchase is on its way.

verifying.title: We got your payment
verifying.body: We're verifying it. Your first purchase from a new Pix account can take up to {{hours}} h; we'll let you know when it's done.

refunded.title: Payment refunded
refunded.body: We sent {{amount}} back to the Pix account that paid.

expired.title: The code expired
expired.body: You weren't charged. You can generate another one.

holds.title: Being verified
holds.body: We got your PIX payment. The first purchase from a new Pix account is verified before delivery; we'll let you know when it's done.

cpf.title: Verify your CPF
cpf.hint: We check it against Brazil's registry using the name and date of birth on your verified document. You only need to do this once.
cpf.label: CPF

verified.title: CPF verified
verified.body: You can now pay for your purchases with PIX from Brazil.

errors.invalid: This CPF isn't valid. Check the 11 digits.
errors.no_match: The details don't match Brazil's registry.
errors.partial: We couldn't confirm your CPF: the match is partial or it isn't in good standing.
errors.in_use: This CPF is already linked to another account. Contact support if it's yours.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The registry didn't respond. No attempt was used; try again.

block.GOLD_REQUIRED: CPF verification is available for GOLD accounts.
block.KYC_REQUIRED: First verify your identity with your document.
block.DOCUMENT_REQUIRED: We need the name and date of birth on your verified document. Verify your identity again.
block.MINOR: You must be of legal age to pay with PIX.
block.UNAVAILABLE: PIX payment isn't available right now.
block.GEO_BR_REQUIRED: CPF verification is only available from Brazil.
